{
  "analysis": "I've created the compat headers, linker script, and identified the libgcc path. Now I need to create a build script that compiles all doomgeneric C files except platform-specific ones (SDL, X11, allegro, emscripten, soso, sosox, win), uses doomgeneric_img.c as the platform file, and links with libgcc. The build must use freestanding flags with the mipsel cross-compiler.",
  "plan": "Create and run a build script that compiles all needed C files with -nostdinc -Icompat -I. -msoft-float -march=mips32 -mno-abicalls -fno-pic -G 0 -nostdlib, then links with the linker script and libgcc. After building, verify the ELF has a `main` symbol and .text/.data/.rodata sections.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat > build.sh << 'BEOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

CC=mipsel-linux-gnu-gcc
CFLAGS="-Os -Wall -Wno-implicit-function-declaration -Wno-incompatible-pointer-types -Wno-int-conversion -Wno-builtin-declaration-mismatch -Wno-discarded-qualifiers -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-unused-label -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-sign-compare -Wno-format -Wno-format-extra-args -Wno-maybe-uninitialized -Wno-stringop-overread -Wno-stringop-truncation -Wno-attributes -Wno-pedantic-ms-format"
CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -DNORMALUNIX -DLINUX -DSNDSERV -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D__linux__ -D__MIPSEL__ -D__mips__ -D__mipsel__"
CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -nostdinc -Icompat -Icompat/sys -I. -msoft-float -march=mips32 -mno-abicalls -fno-pic -G 0 -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector -fno-common"
LDFLAGS="-nostdlib -nostartfiles -msoft-float -march=mips32 -mno-abicalls -fno-pic -G 0 -Wl,-T,doom.lds -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-Map,doomgeneric_mips.map"
LIBGCC=$(mipsel-linux-gnu-gcc -print-libgcc-file-name)

OBJDIR=build_mips
mkdir -p $OBJDIR

# Get all C files except platform-specific ones
SRCS=$(ls *.c | grep -v '_sdl\.c\|_xlib\.c\|_allegro\|_emscripten\|_soso\|_sosox\|_win\.c\|i_sdlmusic\|i_sdlsound\|i_allegro' | sort)

echo "=== Compiling ==="
for src in $SRCS; do
    obj="$OBJDIR/${src%.c}.o"
    echo "  CC $src"
    $CC $CFLAGS -c "$src" -o "$obj" 2>&1 | grep -v 'warning:' || true
    if [ ! -f "$obj" ]; then
        echo "FAILED: $src"
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "=== Linking ==="
OBJS=$(ls $OBJDIR/*.o | sort)
$CC $CFLAGS $LDFLAGS $OBJS $LIBGCC -o /app/doomgeneric_mips 2>&1 || { echo "Link failed"; exit 1; }

echo "=== Done ==="
mipsel-linux-gnu-size /app/doomgeneric_mips
mipsel-linux-gnu-readelf -h /app/doomgeneric_mips | head -20
mipsel-linux-gnu-nm /app/doomgeneric_mips | grep -w main
mipsel-linux-gnu-readelf -S /app/doomgeneric_mips | grep -E '\.text|\.data|\.rodata|\.bss'
BEOF
chmod +x build.sh
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "./build.sh
",
      "duration": 10.0
    }
  ]
}
